models.description: Provisional 2026-09-20 guidance: default for bounded exploration, grounded summaries, test triage and small clearly specified changes. Require file references and tests for edits. Use the user's preferred Luna xhigh for bounded implementation or detailed investigation, and Sol high for difficult multi-file changes; these are task choices, not mandatory sequential steps. Benchmark-informed, not yet calibrated on this Pi workload.

User-preferred as of 2026-09-20 based on positive practical experience: choose directly for bounded implementation, detailed investigation and scoped debugging. This is the deliberate exception to generally avoiding above-high reasoning. Require tests and grounded evidence. Move to Sol high for substantially interacting or broad multi-file changes rather than automatically raising Luna to max; no local comparative win rate is claimed.

Provisional 2026-09-20 guidance: primary implementation and escalation choice for multi-step debugging, interacting constraints and substantial multi-file changes. Prefer this over routinely increasing Terra to xhigh/max or Luna to max; retain the user's preferred Luna xhigh for bounded work. Require behavioral/regression tests and patch review. Use Grok for a cross-provider second opinion when useful; higher reasoning is not automatically better value.

Provisional 2026-09-20 guidance: efficient second-provider implementation, investigation and review candidate using the SuperGrok route. DeepSWE supports trying medium for long-horizon engineering without assuming high is always better. Use as an alternative when another provider or viewpoint is useful; compare accepted outcomes, not model confidence. Require evidence and tests.

Provisional 2026-09-20 guidance: Grok escalation for ambiguous multi-file tasks and demanding cross-provider review. CursorBench favors high over medium, while DeepSWE does not show a corresponding improvement; choose by task and observed outcomes. Avoid routine xhigh escalation for its small published incremental gains. Findings remain hypotheses until independently checked.
